decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on tightly linked to the firm’s core web-mapping offer, it is cheap to keep open and the repeated early releases suggest the option still has unresolved upside.

This plugin fits the established portfolio and likely has low carrying cost, but its more limited prominence on the website makes it a somewhat weaker option that could be pruned if demand stays thin.

The product addresses a clear mobile usability problem in the firm’s core domain and was promoted prominently, so management would likely keep the option alive while market feedback continues to develop.
As a flagship platform aligned with the firm’s stated direction, it is strategically central and management would be very unlikely to abandon it so soon despite ongoing uncertainty.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm’s integrated geospatial solutions business, and with uncertainty still high after launch it makes sense to preserve this option rather than exit early.

The search extension is a modular complement to the core web-map stack and therefore inexpensive to maintain, though some overlap with related search offerings creates a moderate chance of later consolidation.
